Carla (Growth): Heads-up — prepping the launch drip for the benchmark webinar on Apr 6. Need: copy variants for nurture, segment rules, send windows, and tracking plan. Goal = webinar signups -> qualified leads. Quick sync here, please. :rocket:

Mike (Content): I can draft 3 subject lines and 2 preview texts by EOD. Initial ideas: 
- Subject A: 'How we cut inference costs by 3x — Webinar Apr 6'
- Subject B: 'Run LLMs cheaper: Live benchmark + playbook'
- Subject C (conversational): 'Curious how inference scales? Join our benchmark demo'
Preview suggestions: 'Live demo + cost + Q&A' / 'Benchmarks, configs, and rollout tips'

Anya (Ops): Segment rules proposal (keep simple):
- engaged_trialers = last_30d_active AND trial=true AND opened_1+ in last 14d
- cold_leads = last_90d_no_activity AND opened_0 in last 60d
- enterprise_targets = company_size>200 AND role IN (platform, infra, eng)
Make sure we suppress 'unsubscribed' and 'do_not_contact' lists. Also: include a hard suppression for anyone who attended previous benchmark webinar.

Oli (Campaigns): Send windows & cadence thoughts: 
- Stagger rollouts by region: NA morning (10am ET), EMEA morning (10am CET), APAC morning (10am SGT).
- Drip cadence: Day 0 (invite), Day 3 (reminder + CF testimonial), Day 7 (last chance), Day 14 (on-demand recording + trial nudge)
- A/B test: Subject A vs Subject C on first send, 20% sample each, then winner -> remaining 60% after 6 hours.
- UTM pattern: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=benchmark_apr6&utm_medium=email&utm_content={variant}

Marisol (Design): I need final hero image and 600x200 banner variants for A/B. Can we decide tone? Options: 1) product-focused graph (cost/latency) 2) human story (engineer at laptop). Leaning to #1 for benchmarks. Will mock two comps by tomorrow.

Nora (Eng): Quick data caveat — the 'company_size' enrichment might lag for newly-signed leads; recommend fallback to 'company_size_unknown' bucket to avoid misrouting. Also I can expose an 'inference_profile' tag for customers who have called the inference API in the last 60d (useful for targeting).

Mike (Content): Copy variants for the body (short snippets):
- Variant 1 (technical): 'Join our engineers as they walk through real-world throughput and latency tradeoffs, kernel choices, and quantization lessons from a 1B-token benchmark.'
- Variant 2 (business): 'See how teams reduce token spend and keep latency predictable — live demo + Q&A with our SREs.'
- Variant 3 (playful): 'Benchmarks, tips, and a smug look at our token bills — come see what actually moves the needle.' :smile:

marketing-bot: Campaign created: id=cmp_20260406_benchmark_drip, workspace=marketing, owner=Carla (Growth)

Carla (Growth): Tracker + checklist for launch: 
- Finalize subject lines & winner test (Mike)
- Confirm segment filters + suppression (Anya + Nora)
- Design comps (Marisol)
- Setup campaign & UTMs in SFMC/Hub (Oli)
- QA send to seed list and spam-check (Oli + Anya)
- Measurement: open rate, click -> signup rate, webinar attendance, post-webinar trial conversion (Marisol, Mike responsible for content conversion copy)

Oli (Campaigns): I'll put draft audience lists into the campaign and spin up the A/B. Can someone tag product folks for a one-paragraph playbook we can include in follow-ups? @Mike can you coordinate the playbook copy?

Mike (Content): Yep — will drop 1-paragraph playbook and 3 actionable config tips by tomorrow morning.

Anya (Ops): One more ops note — use throttling for the first burst to avoid SES rate limits. Stagger sends by 1 minute per 2000 recipients. Also ensure DKIM/SPF alignment and include List-Unsubscribe header.

Carla (Growth): Perfect. Assigning owners: Mike = copy, Marisol = creative, Anya = segments + suppression, Oli = campaign orchestration + send, Nora = data hooks. I'll review final QA on Thursday. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Marisol (Design): Quick Q — do we want to include a short customer quote in the hero? helps CTR.

Carla (Growth): Yes — short quote ok if we have permission. @Oli can you check legal/permission?

Oli (Campaigns): On it. Will confirm by EOD.

Nora (Eng): I'll expose the inference_profile tag before the seed run. ETA tomorrow noon.

Carla (Growth): Great — we'll reconvene in this thread for final sign-off. :eyes:
